verdict.rationale: AgentMail provides webhook and WebSocket infrastructure so an agent's inbox can react to new email events in real time without polling, which supports autonomous background operation, and its human-in-the-loop cc/bcc feature suggests it's designed for agent-driven workflows. However, there's no documented scheduler, cron, or dedicated 'automation' orchestration feature — it only provides the event-plumbing an agent could use to build such automations itself. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduling/automation-run feature, evidence of actual autonomous agent workflows running unattended, and independent confirmation of reliability of webhooks/websockets in production.
